newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Italian president arrives in Morocco.
newsitem.headline: Italian president arrives in Morocco.

text.p: Italian President Oscar Luigi Scalfaro arrived in Morocco on Tuesday to start a three-day visit during which he will hold talks with King Hassan.
The president, who was met at Rabat airport by Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali, made no statement and left directly for Rabat to meet the king.
During his stay, the president will visit the Hassan Mosque in Casablanca and accompany King Hassan to inaugurate Morocco's largest dam, built with Italian financial help.
